exposure.needed: which custom setup in the environment (e.g. custom Services, label selectors, monitoring or other tooling) leverages the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label on Strimzi pods or external listener Services

consequence.statement: A custom setup that leverages the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label stops working after the upgrade because the label is no longer applied to pods and external listener Kubernetes Services.
consequence.remediation: Replace any use of the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label with the strimzi.io/pod-name label.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removed the statefulset.kubernetes.io/pod-name label from pods and external listeners Kubernetes Services, and any custom setup leveraging that label must use the strimzi.io/pod-name label instead.
